newsitem.title: UK: Sims Food may have overstated profits.
newsitem.headline: Sims Food may have overstated profits.

text.p: Sims Food Group Plc, the meat processing group, said on Tuesday that it has uncovered a breakdown of financial controls at its processing plant in Carnaby.

The company warned that this may show that management accounts have overstated profits by up to 1.7 million stg for the year to March 31, 1997 and lead to losses of up to 1.5 million stg at the plant.
